verdict.rationale: A runtime probe fetched an OpenAPI 3.1 spec titled 'Superset API' from https://api.superset.sh/openapi.json without a key, and the product's llms.txt lists an OpenAPI spec among its machine-readable resources. The 404s on docs.superset.sh paths are a different host and do not contradict this. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing the spec's scope and versioning.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: keyless GET of https://api.superset.sh/openapi.json returned the OpenAPI 3.1 spec — title 'Superset API'
